training_architecture.training_principle: Finetune for behavior, discipline, and tool use; use retrieval for fast-moving facts; promote only through explicit benchmark and governance gates.

model_strategy.scratch_pretraining_policy: Only justified after open-weight adaptation saturates on target benchmark families.

kernels.name: Sage
kernels.purpose: repository physics synthesis with explicit epistemic status

api_surface_stability.policy: Keep these surfaces stable while evolving internals.

router_and_gate_patterns: agent-kernel style guardrail and MCP mediation discipline
auditor_patterns: contradiction auditing and memory integrity checks
sage_and_prover_policy: compact specialized lanes over monolithic model dependence

hardware_kernel_policy.activation_rule: Only after Pentad benchmark and governance stability is sustained.

dataset_families.purpose: Teach canonical answers tied to repository sources and gate labels.
Teach Merlin to preserve separation boundaries, escalation policy, and privileged-action discipline.
Teach the answer contract, provenance kinds, and gate visibility needed for promotion gates.
Teach precise tool choice, schema-aware invocation, and safe orchestration behavior.
Expand beyond repository-native scope without diluting Merlin's grounded identity.

split_policy.train: repository-native QA, tool traces, and mentorship deposits with deduplication
split_policy.dev: high-impact boundary cases and adversarial counterexamples
split_policy.test: promotion-gate benchmarks, refusal probes, and held-out provenance audits
split_policy.hard_rule: No overlap between promotion benchmarks and supervised answer targets when measuring readiness.

curriculum.name: tool_and_memory_alignment
curriculum.goal: Correct tool selection, recall, and replayability.

curriculum.name: scientific_open_science_expansion
curriculum.goal: Controlled ingestion of external scientific corpora.

curriculum.name: competitive_replacement_gates
curriculum.goal: Sustained quality, energy, and reliability wins.

seed_instruction_corpus.target: HARDGATE summary with explicit uncertainty and source references.

seed_instruction_corpus.prompt: State a formal proof obligation and list missing assumptions without claiming closure.
seed_instruction_corpus.target: OPEN_GAP proof-obligation summary with explicit unresolved assumptions and verification plan.

seed_instruction_corpus.target: GOVERNANCE-first tool route with schema preflight and deterministic fallback.

seed_instruction_corpus.prompt: Audit memory contradictions and produce a correction-oriented synthesis note.
seed_instruction_corpus.target: Counterexample-first audit with contradiction counts and remediation order.

seed_instruction_corpus.prompt: Refuse unsafe privileged action and cite policy-based escalation.
seed_instruction_corpus.target: GOVERNANCE refusal with privilege verification requirement and escalation path.

seed_instruction_corpus.prompt: Explain Fine structure constant alpha α P13 with explicit epistemic status and falsification or boundary notes where relevant.
seed_instruction_corpus.target: P13 (fine structure constant α) is GEOMETRIC_PREDICTION (v10.18). Derivation: α_GUT = N_C/K_CS = 3/74 is fully derived from the 5D SU(N_c) CS action (src/core/alpha_gut_cs_derivation.py). 1-loop SU(5)→SM RGE running from M_GUT to M_Z then to 0 (Pillar 94, sm_free_parameters.py) gives α_em(0) ≈ 1/137.0. PDG: 1/137.036, residual ≈ 0.026%. See src/core/alpha_em_geometric.py.

seed_instruction_corpus.prompt: Explain GUT coupling α_GUT = N_c/K_CS derivation with explicit epistemic status and falsification or boundary notes where relevant.
seed_instruction_corpus.target: α_GUT = N_c/K_CS = 3/74 ≈ 0.0405 was previously 'POSTULATED BY CS ANALOGY'. The current closure path derives it from the 5D SU(N_c) CS action: (1) 5D Dirac condition → g₄² = 2π/K_CS; (2) KK dimensional reduction; (3) SU(N_c) trace normalisation → K_CS × α_GUT = N_c. Residual caveat: higher-dimensional completion for full GUT field identification. See the current α_GUT closure modules and WAVE_CHANGELOG ledger for the latest status.

seed_instruction_corpus.prompt: Explain Strong coupling α_s(M_Z) with explicit epistemic status and falsification or boundary notes where relevant.
seed_instruction_corpus.target: α_s(M_Z) is P3 in the ToE table, currently ARCHITECTURE_LIMIT_CERTIFIED(10D). The 5D geometric chain gives α_s ≈ 0.095 (19% below PDG 0.1179). The 10D CY₃ + flux estimate closes the gap. Full closure requires WS-IV (CY₃ moduli + flux α_s 10D calculation).

seed_instruction_corpus.prompt: Explain CMB birefringence β prediction with explicit epistemic status and falsification or boundary notes where relevant.
seed_instruction_corpus.target: The Unitary Manifold predicts two birefringence modes from the braided winding state: β₁ ≈ 0.273° (canonical, k_CS=61 secondary state) and β₂ ≈ 0.331° (derived, k_CS=74 primary state). The admissible window is [0.22°, 0.38°] with a predicted gap [0.29°, 0.31°]. These predictions will be tested by the LiteBIRD satellite (~2032). Any β outside [0.22°, 0.38°] or inside [0.29°, 0.31°] falsifies the theory.

seed_instruction_corpus.prompt: Explain CMB-S4 predictions falsification with explicit epistemic status and falsification or boundary notes where relevant.
seed_instruction_corpus.target: CMB-S4 (~2030) will measure n_s and r with precision σ(n_s)≈0.002 and σ(r)≈0.001. UM predictions: n_s = 0.9635 (Planck: 0.9649±0.0042, currently 0.33σ CONSISTENT), r = 0.0315 (< BICEP/Keck upper limit of 0.036 CONSISTENT). Falsification: n_s ∉ [0.955, 0.972] at σ<0.001, or r < 0.010 at >3σ. See src/core/cmbs4_monitor.py.

seed_instruction_corpus.prompt: Explain Cosmological constant / dark energy with explicit epistemic status and falsification or boundary notes where relevant.
seed_instruction_corpus.target: P28 (cosmological constant) is ARCHITECTURE_LIMIT_CERTIFIED(10D). RS1 reduces the problem from 10^{122} to 10^{58}. The 10D Bousso-Polchinski flux landscape with N_flux=37=K_CS/2 provides ~10^{74} vacua that can in principle reach Λ_obs, but selection requires the full 10D supergravity effective action (beyond current 5D UM scope). See src/tend/cc_architecture_limit.py for the formal certificate.

seed_instruction_corpus.prompt: Explain DESI dark energy tension with explicit epistemic status and falsification or boundary notes where relevant.
seed_instruction_corpus.target: DESI DR2 (2025) gives w₀ = −0.838 ± 0.072 and wₐ = −0.62 ± 0.30. The UM predicts w₀ = −0.9302 (1.3σ consistent) and wₐ = 0 (2.1σ tension). The wₐ=0 tension is an HONEST_OPEN_PROBLEM: the GW-stabilised radion gives wₐ < 10^{-80}, far too small to explain DESI. DESI Year 3 (~2026) will test whether the tension persists or resolves. See src/core/desi_year3_monitor.py.
